title: Longest Semi-Repeating Subarray
summary: Given an integer array nums of length n and an integer k, find the longest contiguous subarray where at most k elements repeat.
statement: Given an integer array nums of length n and an integer k, find the longest contiguous subarray where at most k elements repeat. Return the length of this subarray.
constraints: At most k distinct values may have frequency greater than one in the window.
Return the maximum valid contiguous length.
reference_solution:
def longest_semi_repeating_subarray(nums,k):
    counts={};repeated=0;left=0;answer=0
    for right,value in enumerate(nums):
        counts[value]=counts.get(value,0)+1
        if counts[value]==2:repeated+=1
        while repeated>k:
            old=nums[left];counts[old]-=1
            if counts[old]==1:repeated-=1
            left+=1
        answer=max(answer,right-left+1)
    return answer

hints: A value changes the repeated-value count only when its frequency crosses between one and two.
Use a sliding window and shrink whenever more than k distinct values repeat.
Increment on frequency two; during shrinking, decrement after frequency falls to one.
The left boundary is the earliest valid boundary for each right endpoint, so every maximum window is considered.
